novelty.justification: The claim’s core route is a new mechanistic reinterpretation, namely that the “linear 'truth direction' ... actually encodes assertability/belief-as-asserted” rather than world-truth, with a specific predicted dissociation between “confidently-asserted falsehoods” and “true propositions framed as mere hearsay.” The closest prior works I found by searching “truth direction belief probe assertability,” “truth probes fact belief distinction,” and “LLM truth direction endorsement” are Azaria and Mitchell’s truthfulness probing, Marks and Tegmark’s CCS work, “Probing the Geometry of Truth” (ACL 2025), “The Trilemma of Truth in Large Language Models” (2025), and “Belief in the Machine” (2024); these study truth-direction geometry, probe reliability, or behavioral fact/belief confusion, but do not propose that truth probes specifically measure endorsement/assertability or embed that prediction in false-belief contexts. The step from these works to the claim is therefore a new core relationship rather than a direct transfer or mere object change, warranting a high-within-framework novelty score, though not a paradigm-level score because it repurposes established probes and does not introduce a general measurement paradigm.
